Description (SPA): Identificador de publicación asignado por el Senado.
Description (ENG): Publication identifier assigned by the Senado.
Notes: The source's own 'ID Publicación'; used directly as the primary key, not a derived hash.

Description (SPA): Categoría del asunto tal como la reporta la herramienta de origen.
Description (ENG): Category of the matter as reported by the source tool.
Values / Domain: e.g. Iniciativas; Iniciativas de Legisladoras y Legisladores.
Notes: Both observed categories cover legislator-authored initiatives from the tipo=Inic feed.

Description (SPA): Título o descripción de la iniciativa.
Description (ENG): Title or description of the initiative.
Notes: Everything in the source entry after the matched proposer clause; the full entry text when unmatched (needs_review=1).

Description (SPA): Tipo de proponente clasificado por expresión regular.
Notes: The tipo=Inic feed only covers legislator-authored initiatives; Ejecutivo federal and Minuta items live under the separate tipo=PEF / tipo=Minutas feeds, not crawled here.

Description (SPA): Nombre del legislador proponente cuando se identifica.
Notes: NULL for otro rows, including most multi-signatory initiatives the regex could not cleanly split.

Description (SPA): Grupo parlamentario del proponente cuando se identifica, tal como lo reporta la fuente.
Description (ENG): Proposer's parliamentary group, when identified, exactly as reported by the source.
Notes: Raw source text: may be a full official name, an abbreviation, or -- for multi-signatory initiatives -- contaminated with co-signer names. See proposer_party_canonical.

Description (SPA): Partido normalizado a la misma clave usada en el resto del proyecto.
Description (ENG): Party normalized to the same key used elsewhere in the project.
Values / Domain: MORENA, PAN, PRI, PVEM, PT, MC, IND, or NULL.
Notes: Derived from proposer_party by ingestion.congress_roster_ingest.canonical_party_from_text(); NULL when no recognizable party name or abbreviation was found in the source text (about 0.3% of legislador rows) -- not guessed.

Description (SPA): Texto fuente que sustenta la clasificación del proponente.
Description (ENG): Source text supporting the proposer classification.

Description (SPA): Comisión a la que fue turnada la iniciativa.
Description (ENG): Committee the initiative was referred to.
Notes: Parsed from a 'Se dio turno directo a la Comisión de...' source line; absent for some entries.

Description (SPA): Fecha de publicación de la iniciativa.

Notes: Points at the full Gaceta del Senado / Comisión Permanente bulletin document.

Description (SPA): Indica si el texto del proponente no coincidió con ninguna plantilla conocida.
Description (ENG): Whether the proposer text didn't match any known template.
Notes: About 4% of rows; mostly multi-signatory joint initiatives. title is always preserved regardless.
